text:
lena: Quick question from the Acme security review: they want our canonical answer for 'are service logs included in DSARs' and the retention of logs tied to a POC tenant. Their security ops wants explicit retention numbers.

eirik: We generally treat application request/response logs separately from customer content. For Hosted: access logs (IP, request meta) 90 days, request payloads 30 days by default under DPA. For Dedicated we can set custom retention.

samira: Can confirm: for hosted POC tenants we can do an ad-hoc immediate purge of request payloads and flag logs for expedited deletion, but we need a written DSAR request and legal sign-off.

lena: They also asked whether we support export for DSAR (to give users their data). We do: CSV export of request metadata + full-text export of user-submitted content via our admin export API.

legal-liaison: Be explicit in the reply: mention our DPA link and that SCCs are supported. For POC we can offer a time-limited addendum to shorten retention. Samira, please attach the sanitized admin export command.

samira: Paste (sanitized):
```
# admin export
GET /internal/admin/export?customer_id=acme-123&format=fulltext
```

lena: I'll reply with the combined note and route the redline. Keep it short.

eirik: Also throw in that we log audit entries for every deletion/export with UUID and timestamp; that's usually enough for vendor risk teams.

lena: Sending now.
